name: Funabori Onee-san
source:
"Because it's a festival, as long as it's fun, then anything is fine. It's been that way for a long time."

Likes: Radio, photograph

Self-proclaimed "Funabori Onee-san Sensei", no one knows her real name.

Usually, she works as a teacher at the school where [url=/c113574]Kyouhei[/url] and [url=/c113577]Remi[/url] attend. But sometimes, she is also a police officer, a convenience store clerk, an insurance doctor, and so on. A mysterious woman who often appears in various places and various appearances.

Although she has a variety of looks, she doesn't have a close relationship with anyone and her private life remains a mystery.

At first glance, she doesn't seem to be thinking about anything, and with her happy-go-lucky personality, she likes to tease Kyouhei in funny and humorous ways.

She gives off a carefree vibe, but on the other hand, her motto is to perform her work perfectly. In fact, she can handles any task flawlessly as a competent adult.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/funabori.html]Official website[/url]]
